description: This file defines a utility class 'ChangeLocale' that provides a static method to change the system locale programmatically on an Android device, utilizing system services like ActivityManager and Configuration.

classes.name: ChangeLocale
classes.description: A helper class to change the system locale on an Android device.

methods.name: changeSystemLocale
methods.description: Sets the system locale to a new locale specified by a string in the format 'ab_AB'. Handles the configuration update through system services.
